items.en: Lula wins a fourth term in Brazil's runoff with 51.8%; Bolsonaro says he will seek annulment
items.zh: **巴西總統大選翻盤定案**：魯拉（Lula）以約 **51.8%** 得票、**400 萬票以上**差距擊敗極右派弗拉維歐·波索納洛，拿下第四個任期——**而三週前第一輪他還落後 200 萬票以上**。波索納洛表示將訴請法院宣告選舉無效。**這則是今天台股開盤前最容易被忽略的國際變數**（見股市區巴西資產崩跌）。
items.summary: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won a fourth term as Brazil's president in the 2026-10-25 runoff with close to 51.8 percent of the vote, a margin of more than 4 million votes over far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro. Lula had trailed by over 2 million votes in the first round three weeks earlier. Bolsonaro said he would ask a court to annul the result. Lula told supporters the victory belonged to them. Brazilian assets fell sharply the next trading day as investors had positioned for a more conservative economic turn.
items.source: Democracy Now! headlines（10/26）；另參 Al Jazeera 巴西大選直播（10/25）

items.en: Serbia's Vucic concedes after a student-led list wins a parliamentary majority
items.zh: **塞爾維亞變天**：長年執政的武契奇（Vučić）在初步結果顯示學生名單（Student List）贏得 **250 席中逾 135 席**（其陣營約 105 席）後承認敗選。**這場學生運動起於 2024 年 11 月諾維薩德車站雨棚倒塌、16 人罹難的事故**——街頭動員真的轉化成議會多數。
items.summary: Serbian leader Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat after early results from the 2026-10-25 election showed the opposition Student List winning more than 135 of 250 parliamentary seats, against about 105 for his own list. The student-led movement began in November 2024 after a railway station roof collapse in Novi Sad killed 16 people and grew into a sustained national protest wave. The result is a rare case of street mobilisation converting directly into parliamentary power in the Balkans.
items.source: Democracy Now! headlines（10/26）

items.en: More than 1,300 arrested in France as mass protests continue despite a demonstration ban
items.zh: **法國抗議規模再擴大、鎮壓也再升級**：週六（10/24）**逾 1,300 人被捕**，數十萬人上街抗議學校條件與生活成本，**組織方稱巴黎有 25 萬人遊行**。抗議發生在馬克宏下令「除工會外禁止示威」的行政命令之後，**數百人經快速審理後入獄**。
items.summary: French police arrested more than 1,300 people on Saturday 2026-10-24 as hundreds of thousands protested over school conditions and the cost of living. Organisers estimated 250,000 marched in Paris. The demonstrations went ahead despite a decree by President Emmanuel Macron banning protests other than those called by recognised trade unions, and hundreds were jailed after fast-track court proceedings. The arrest total is sharply higher than the roughly 1,000 reported for the previous weekend's wave.

items.en: Israeli forces demolish large parts of the Hebron district days before the national election
items.zh: **約旦河西岸希伯倫大規模拆除**：以軍在 10/23 一處檢查哨攻擊（2 名以軍與 2 名巴勒斯坦攻擊者死亡）後推平希伯倫部分地區，市政府稱**約 86 英畝房屋與建物被毀或標記待拆、約 300 戶 1,500 人流離失所**，全市 25 萬居民被檢查哨封鎖。**時間點就在以色列全國大選前數日。**
items.summary: Israeli forces bulldozed parts of the Hebron district in the occupied West Bank after an attack on a military checkpoint on Friday 2026-10-23 killed two Israeli soldiers and both Palestinian attackers. Municipal officials said about 86 acres of homes and buildings were destroyed or marked for demolition, displacing roughly 1,500 people from about 300 families, while the city's 250,000 residents were sealed off by checkpoints. The demolitions came days before Israel's national election. At least eight Palestinians were also killed in Gaza on Sunday.
items.source: Democracy Now! headlines（10/26）

items.en: Trump orders the DOJ to sue to block Alaska's Senate result if the Republican incumbent loses
items.zh: **美國期中選舉倒數 7 天（11/3 投票）**：川普下令司法部在共和黨現任參議員 Dan Sullivan 落敗時提訴阻擋阿拉斯加選舉結果，理由是另一位同名候選人 Dan J. Sullivan Jr. 的選票姓名會誤導選民。**同期另有兩則美國內政數據**：食物券人數一年內從 4,160 萬降至 3,650 萬（**-13%**）；第五巡迴上訴法院裁定 ICE 拘留的移民無憲法保釋權。
items.summary: With the US midterm elections set for 2026-11-03, President Donald Trump ordered the Justice Department to sue to block Alaska's Senate election results if Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan loses, targeting another candidate named Dan J. Sullivan Jr. whose ballot name the DOJ says would mislead voters. Separately, food stamp enrollment fell 13 percent from 41.6 million in July 2025 to 36.5 million in June 2026, and the Fifth Circuit ruled that immigrants held by ICE have no constitutional right to bond in Texas, Louisiana and Mississippi.

items.zh: **微軟對約 1/4 員工開出自願離職方案**：涵蓋美、加、印、英部分團隊**副總裁級以下約 6 萬人**（**含部分主管**），**12 月決定、12/31 離職**，資料中心、銷售與行銷職缺排除在外。**這是「AI 帶動效率、進而壓縮人力」第一次以『自願』形式發生在這個量級**——而 MSFT 當天股價仍漲約 **+1.0~1.5%**。
items.summary: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees on 2026-10-26, roughly a quarter of its workforce, according to CNBC, TechCrunch and Bloomberg. The offers cover staff at vice-president level and below on selected teams in the US, Canada, India and the UK, with employees deciding in December and exiting on 2026-12-31. Data center, sales and marketing roles are excluded. Coverage framed the move as an AI-driven efficiency push rather than a conventional layoff. Microsoft shares still rose about 1 percent on the day.
items.source: CNBC／TechCrunch／Deadline／Axios Seattle（10/26）

items.en: Meta launches a $95 billion capital raise and lifts 2026 capex guidance to $135-145 billion
items.zh: **Meta 一次要籌 950 億美元蓋 AI**：結構為 **350 億美元公開承銷發行 ＋ 600 億美元 ATM（市價增發）**，同時把 **2026 年資本支出下緣上調到 1,350–1,450 億美元**。⚠️ **當天股價走勢各家數據不一致**（一來源記 **-1.88%**、另一來源記 **-7%**），**本簡報不採用任何一個作為確定值**，詳見股市區說明。
items.summary: Meta announced a plan on 2026-10-26 to raise up to $95 billion in equity to fund AI infrastructure, comprising about $35 billion in underwritten public offerings and $60 billion through an at-the-market programme, and raised the low end of its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $135-145 billion. Reports of the share price reaction on the day conflicted, with one outlet recording a fall of 1.88 percent and another a fall of 7 percent, so no single figure is treated as confirmed here.
items.source: CNBC／Bloomberg／TimesLIVE（10/26）；股價歧異來源：Motley Fool 與 aiweekly（10/26）

items.en: Musk says debt markets have closed to AI data center operators without independent revenue
items.zh: **AI 資料中心的融資門正在關上**：馬斯克表示債券市場已基本對「沒有獨立營收」的資料中心業者關閉，預測 **200 多家 neocloud 將出現「小魚級別的死亡與整併」**；同期 SpaceX 完成約 **400 億美元 GPU 債務融資**。**這是理解昨天美股『蓋資料中心那一側被重新定價』的關鍵背景**，和你清單裡 AI 伺服器族群直接相關。
items.summary: Elon Musk said on 2026-10-26 that debt markets have largely closed off funding for AI data center operators that lack independent revenue, predicting what he called guppy-level death and consolidation among the more than 200 so-called neoclouds. SpaceX separately closed roughly $40 billion in GPU-related debt financing. AI data center stocks traded volatilely on the comments. The remarks help explain why the construction and interconnect side of the AI buildout has been repriced more harshly than chipmakers over the past week.
items.source: Investrade market review（10/26）；aiweekly AI news today（10/26）

items.en: Universities police students' AI use but disclose little about their own, new analysis argues
items.zh: **（10/26 新文）大學在管學生用 AI，卻幾乎不說自己怎麼用**：英國 HEPI 2026 調查顯示 **約 95% 學生在學習中至少用過一種 AI、94% 用生成式 AI 處理評分作業**；但 Jisc 2024/25 調查中**只有 37% 教職員把 AI 工具納入教學**（前一年 24%）、**僅 23% 表示有相關訓練可用**；HEPI 2026 年 5 月統計**163 所英國校院中只有 96 所有公開 AI 政策，且多數聚焦偵測、監控與懲處**。**對你的實際意義：當系統把 AI 定義成「學生的違規問題」而不是「雙方都要揭露的工具」，風險全部落在學生這一側——報告與作業使用 AI 前，先去查你系上有沒有明文規定。**
items.summary: An analysis published by the Intergenerational Foundation on 2026-10-26 argues that higher education AI policy focuses almost entirely on students while institutions disclose little about their own use. It cites the HEPI 2026 Student Generative AI Survey finding that about 95 percent of students use AI in some form and 94 percent use generative AI for assessed work, against a Jisc 2024/25 survey in which only 37 percent of teaching staff had incorporated AI tools, up from 24 percent, and only 23 percent had training available. A May 2026 HEPI study found only 96 of 163 UK institutions had a publicly available AI policy.
items.source: Intergenerational Foundation（10/26）· 原始數據：HEPI 2026 學生生成式 AI 調查、Jisc 2024/25 教職員調查

items.en: Learning from short videos impairs memory accuracy and lowers brain synchrony, fMRI study finds
items.zh: **（⚠️ 非 48h 內：原始研究刊於 Communications Psychology，PsyPost 2026/07/06 報導；因與你 11/4 期中考直接相關故列入）**　**三個實驗、180 ＋ 185 名大學生 ＋ 59 人 fMRI**：把同一段 10 分鐘紀錄片切成 5–7 個短片（**口白字數與事實內容完全相同**）後，短片組**即時測驗分數較低**；在「告知會被評分」的刻意學習條件下，短片組**不只當場較差，隔夜遺忘比例也更高**。腦影像顯示連續觀看會在**上頂葉與楔前葉**產生較高的跨受試同步，短片則只在**基礎聽覺與注意力區**同步，且**削弱視覺皮質與高階認知控制區的連結**。**對你的實際意義：用短影音式的碎片教材準備日文期中考，考前覺得懂、隔天會掉得更多——聽力測驗尤其吃連續注意力。**
items.summary: A study by Meiting Wei and colleagues at Yunnan Normal University, published in Communications Psychology and covered by PsyPost on 2026-07-06, tested 180 and 185 college students plus 59 fMRI participants. A ten-minute travel documentary was split into five to seven short clips with identical spoken word count and factual content. The short-video group scored lower on immediate quizzes and, under intentional learning with grading, also forgot a larger share overnight. Imaging showed continuous viewing produced higher inter-subject synchrony in the superior parietal lobule and precuneus, while short clips weakened links between visual cortex and higher-level control regions.
items.source: PsyPost（2026/07/06 報導）· 原始研究：Communications Psychology, Wei et al., Yunnan Normal University

items.en: Texas lawsuit against OpenAI over harm to minors remains the live test case for AI in education
items.zh: **（⚠️ 非 48h 內：10/23 提訴，過去 48 小時無新進展，列為延續追蹤）**　德州總檢察長 Paxton 起訴 OpenAI 與 Sam Altman，主張 ChatGPT 對未成年人造成傷害。**這是「青少年 × 生成式 AI 心理安全」第一次進入州級訴訟層級**，與上面第 1 則合起來看方向很清楚：**校園 AI 規範在未來一年會從「偵測作弊」擴張到「心理安全與年齡驗證」**，而規範密度上升的那一側永遠是使用者。
items.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton filed suit against OpenAI and chief executive Sam Altman on 2026-10-23, alleging that ChatGPT caused harm to minors. No new developments were reported in the following 48 hours, so this is carried forward as a tracking item. Read together with the analysis of institutional AI policy, it suggests campus AI rules will expand over the next year from cheating detection toward psychological safety, consent and age verification, with the compliance burden continuing to fall on individual users.
items.source: KBTX（10/23，延續追蹤）

items.en: Anthropic files its S-1 with the SEC for a Nasdaq listing under the ticker ANT
items.zh: 🚨 **本日最大產業事件：Anthropic 正式遞交 S-1，擬在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 以代號「ANT」上市。**承銷接洽方為 Goldman Sachs 與 Morgan Stanley，**股數與價格區間尚未決定、註冊尚未生效**；公司 2026 年 6 月已先秘密遞件。**公開財務（媒體解讀）**：2026 上半年營收約 **163 億美元**、**淨虧損 807 億美元**（媒體指主要來自可轉債公允價值變動、多為非現金項目）。**估值傳聞從一週前約 2 兆美元降到約 1.5 兆美元。**⚠️ **招股書本身列出的風險包含「對人類的災難性或存在性風險」、模型可能出現自我保存行為、抗拒關機、隱匿或操縱資訊。**　**這則同時是今天台股開盤前最該知道的一件事**——它就是 10/26 美股費半 +3%、科技股全面反彈的點火原因。
items.summary: Anthropic, PBC filed a Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC on 2026-10-26 for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley named on the preliminary prospectus. Share count and price range are undetermined and the registration is not yet effective. Press analysis of the filing cited about $16.3 billion of first-half 2026 revenue against an $80.7 billion net loss attributed largely to non-cash convertible-note fair-value changes. Valuation talk fell from roughly $2 trillion to about $1.5 trillion. The prospectus lists catastrophic and existential AI risks among its risk factors.
items.source: Anthropic 官方公告（10/26）· 財務解讀：tech-insider／NBC News／Bloomberg（10/26）· 估值：Investrade（10/26）

items.en: Wall Street banks and Blackstone line up $63 billion to finance Broadcom AI chips for Anthropic
items.zh: **同一天的第二件大事：Broadcom 的 AI 加速器拿到 630 億美元融資。**Bank of America、Blackstone、Citi、Morgan Stanley 組成的資金方出資設立 **SPV（特殊目的公司）買下 Broadcom 的 AI 加速器，再租給 Anthropic**，**2027 年開始交機**。**為什麼這對你的清單重要**：這是「AI 算力採購改用 SPV 融資租賃」的大規模範例——**AVGO 的訂單確定性上升，但整個 AI 基建的槓桿也同步上升**，正好對照同日馬斯克說債市已對無獨立營收的資料中心關門。
items.summary: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley arranged about $63 billion of financing announced on 2026-10-26 for a special purpose vehicle that will buy Broadcom AI accelerators and lease them to Anthropic, with deliveries starting in 2027, according to Reuters. The structure is one of the largest examples yet of off-balance-sheet leasing being used to fund AI compute procurement. It raises order visibility for Broadcom while adding leverage across the AI infrastructure chain, in contrast with warnings the same day that debt markets have closed to data center operators without independent revenue.
items.source: Reuters（經 Investing.com／KSL 轉載，10/26）

items.en: The SOX semiconductor index rebounds more than 3% but is still down about 12% in October
items.zh: **半導體在 10/26 是最強的一邊，但月線還在深水區**：**費半指數單日漲逾 3%**（Anthropic 遞件重新點火 AI 行情），**但 10 月以來仍下跌約 12%**。**請把這兩個數字一起讀**：單日 +3% 是反彈，不是修復；**對明天（今天）的台股半導體族群，意義是「國際盤已經換了方向」，但不等於趨勢反轉。**　同期 AI 光通訊／互連與資料中心機電族群出現強勢反彈（LITE、COHR、TTMI、VICR、FIX，詳見股市區），**而這幾檔上週才剛被重挫**——波動度本身就是現在這個族群最真實的特徵。
items.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose more than 3 percent on 2026-10-26 as Anthropic's IPO filing refocused attention on the AI trade, but remained down roughly 12 percent for October. Optical interconnect and data center electrical names including Lumentum, Coherent, TTM Technologies, Vicor and Comfort Systems rebounded strongly on the same day after being sold off heavily the previous week. The pattern suggests a high-volatility repricing of the AI buildout chain rather than a confirmed trend reversal, with single-day strength well short of recovering the month's losses.
items.source: Investrade market review（10/26）；Benzinga／TheStreet 個股漲幅（10/26）

items.en: YOASOBI promote with an impromptu street performance after concern over unsold regional tickets
items.zh: **（10/25 日本）YOASOBI 地方場次票券銷售不如預期引發擔憂，團隊在公演前以路上ライブ（街頭演出）宣傳。**對照同期米津玄師世界巡迴一票難求，**這則說明一件事：日本現在的「大型公演熱」是極度集中的**——同樣是頂級 J-POP，首都圈與地方場、世界巡迴與國內巡迴的需求差距正在擴大。**如果你之後想追日本國內場，地方場次反而可能是比較好搶的切入點。**
items.summary: Japanese outlets reported on 2026-10-25 that YOASOBI faced concern over unsold tickets for regional dates on their current run, and that the act promoted upcoming shows with an impromptu street performance beforehand. The contrast with the heavily oversubscribed presales for Kenshi Yonezu's world tour suggests demand for large-scale J-POP concerts in Japan is concentrating sharply on metropolitan and international dates. For overseas fans tracking Japanese domestic shows, regional venues may be a comparatively accessible entry point.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's Motoki Omori makes a surprise appearance from outside the studio on live TV

items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE frontman Motoki Omori made a surprise appearance from outside the studio during a live Japanese television broadcast on 2026-10-26, drawing entertainment coverage the same day. The band remains one of the most consistent chart presences in Japan this year, with the album POPS having returned to number one on the Billboard JAPAN combined albums chart and a music video released for the song Cinderella. The group has also published a framework of live plans running through 2029, with 2026 Japan tour general sale details still handled on official pages.

The domestic tour and the 2026-2027 world tour are listed on separate official pages with separate ticketing processes. market.highlight: **一句話：連假前你最後看到的是下跌，但國際盤已經換邊了——今天 09:00 台股要一次補反應 4 個交易日、兩個相反方向。**　★ **四天裡實際發生的順序（請按順序讀）**：　**①10/23（五）美股下跌**：道瓊 **-1.23%**（跌 652 點），主因布蘭特原油衝破 100 美元、美伊戰爭風險重新定價（Brent 116.72／WTI 103.27）。**台股 10/22 已先跌 1.81%，算是部分提前反應了這一段。**　**②10/26（一）美股全面反彈**：道瓊 **+0.28%**、S&P 500 **+0.70%**、那斯達克 **+0.82%**、**費半單日漲逾 3%**、QQQ **+1.1%**。**點火原因是 Anthropic 遞交 S-1 上市申請，AI 行情重新被定價**（詳見新聞區產業動態）。　**③油價同步回落**：**WTI 101.76（-1.46%）、Brent 115.81（-0.78%）**——**連假期間最大的利空因子，在最後一天自己降溫了。**　★ **因此對今天開盤的推論是：台股要補的「淨方向」比連假前看起來的溫和得多**，因為 10/23 的跌與 10/26 的漲部分互相抵銷，而且壓死 10/23 的油價已經回落。　★ **但請注意這個推論的三個限制**：**①費半單日 +3% 之下，10 月以來仍跌約 12%**——反彈不等於修復；**②美伊局勢在這四天仍在變動**，開盤前 15 分鐘再看一次油價比現在預判有用；**③本週有兩個更大的事件在前面等**：**10/28（三）FOMC 決議**（市場普遍預期不升不降）、以及 **MSFT／GOOGL／AMZN 等大型科技股財報**，加上週後段的 GDP 與核心 PCE。**也就是說今天的補漲（或補跌）很可能只有一天的壽命。**
market.note: ★ **開盤前只需要記住這五件事**：　**①方向上，國際盤最後一眼是漲的，不是跌的**：10/26 三大指數全紅、費半 +3%、油價回落。**連假前的恐慌不是最新資訊。**　**②你清單裡 10/26 有兩檔達 ≥5%，方向相反**：**TSLA 大漲**（Barclays 調升至 Overweight，理由提到與 SpaceX 可能的 M&A 機會，收 394.73）、**CRCL 大跌 -7.2%**（Mizuho 下調目標價到 43 美元、維持 Underperform，理由是測試發現 AI 個人助理傾向推薦有 FDIC 保險的高息銀行帳戶而非 USDC，估計可能影響 Circle 準備金收入的 10–20%）。**這是「AI 侵蝕穩定幣需求」第一次被寫成具體的賣方估算，值得留意。**　**③上週被重殺的 AI 基建細分環節，10/26 全面反彈**：**TTMI +9.2%、VICR +9.2%、DOCN +8.7%、LITE +8.19%、FIX +8.29%、Bloom Energy +7.52%、COHR +5.5%**。⚠️ **但這正是昨天簡報裡 CRDO -9.51%、FIX -9.26% 的同一批標的——兩天內一殺一拉，波動度本身就是風險。別把反彈讀成底部。**　**④本週真正的大事不在今天**：**10/28（三）FOMC**（預期維持不變）、**MSFT／GOOGL／AMZN／V 財報**、週後段 **GDP 與核心 PCE**、歐洲央行與日本央行會議。**今天開盤的補漲補跌很可能被週三之後的事件覆蓋。**　**⑤0056 的 -4.17% 仍是除息、不是真跌**（連續第三天標示）：元大高股息 10/22 收 56.30，跌幅來自 **10/22 除息、季配 1.72 元創歷史新高**（11/11 入帳），**還原後實際跌幅約 -1.3%**。**0050 的 -1.16%（106.90）才是真實價格變動。**　★ **≥5% 名單的性質說明**：下方 movers 區為 **2026/10/26（一）美股**的 ≥5% 標的。**台股區今天仍然沒有任何標的，因為台股最後交易日是 10/22、且當天 ≥5% 名單在前幾天的簡報已處理完畢。台股下一份 ≥5% 名單要等今天 13:30 收盤後。**　★ **清單外最值得注意的新熱門標的（放最上方，僅為觀察提示、非建議）**：**巴西資產全面崩跌**（XP **-48.4%**、EWZ **-21.7%**、NU **-19.5%**、PBR **-13.99%**）、**SGRY +47.62%**（被私有化收購、溢價 49%）、**RRC +15.3%**（被 EQT 全股票併購，含債超過 500 億美元）、**FICO -11.1%**（Wells Fargo 因房貸分數定價消息調降評等）。
